title: Quotients of universally catenary Noetherian rings
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian universally catenary ring and let $I\subset A$ be any ideal. Then $A/I$ is universally catenary. [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-exc-excellent-ring]
